TEACHER, browser

Role.TEACHER_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS is exactly
maqam:read plus maqam:vote. Not maqam:update, not
maqam:delete, not maqam:teacher_manage. The enum itself
carries no authorities — the pair is seeded into
extraPermissions on promotion, so an admin can widen it
per user. This diagram assumes the default set.
[caller holds ROLE_TEACHER but has no MaqamTeacherVote row on this record]

text.tspan: MaqamMapper never reads getAudioFileUrl() — MaqamResponseDTO has no such field. buildStreamUrl
puts scheme://host/api/maqam/MAQAM_000042/stream there instead, resolved per request from
X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host.
[for every Range request the audio element issues]
Accept-Ranges: bytes
Content-Disposition: inline
Cache-Control: no-store, private
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
X-Maqam-Code: MAQAM_000042
No S3 URL and no presigned link ever reaches the browser, so there is nothing to download.
[roughly every 10s of playback, and on pause]
Two write styles on purpose. The
session row is a plain JPA save, but the
vote aggregate is a @Modifying bulk
UPDATE whose += and GREATEST
run in SQL, so overlapping pings from
the same teacher cannot lose a delta by
writing back a stale entity.

text.tspan: Both refusals below are enforced by authority and by lookup key, not by hiding buttons in the UI.
[the teacher tries to correct the song metadata]
[the teacher tries to change a peer vote]
POST /vote carries no teacherUserId at all. upsertVote resolves the row
from the authenticated principal alone, so a teacher can never address a
peer MaqamTeacherVote, and bumpListen only ever bumps that same row.
The row is created by assignTeachers with votedAt null, so panel
membership and vote storage are the same record — that is why a missing
row reads as 403 rather than as an empty vote.
